methods.label: Remove the extra counts
methods.explanation: The sum \(10+9\) counts the 4 people in both groups twice. Subtracting 4 removes their extra count, leaving each person in either group counted once: \(10+9-4=15\). There are \(15\) people in total.
methods.levelReason: Correcting the repeated count is the Grade 3 overlap idea. The supporting addition and subtraction are elementary calculations within 20.
